history.body: Hi, I’ve been browsing Pearl Residences while comparing options around Seberang Jaya. Could you give me a general idea of the pricing and what kind of buyer it tends to suit?

Sure. For a rough price reference, one listed category—Block 1B podium blocked, levels 1–4—has a RM328,000 base. Applying the 8% rebate shown in the 14 August 2026 package snapshot gives RM301,760 on that base. That’s dated indicative pricing, not a confirmed current offer or all-in unit price; the current package, exact unit and any applicable car-park or accessory components need confirmation.

The standard Phase 1 home is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so it may suit someone looking specifically for a 3-bedroom layout. Are you mainly comparing for your own stay or as an investment?

I’m still figuring that out—it could be for my own use or a rental, depending on how the numbers and my plans work out. The dated figure is a useful starting point, though I understand it isn’t a current all-in price. I’m just comparing for now.

That makes sense—you don’t need to decide between own use and rental yet. One useful holding-cost figure for comparing is the maintenance fee: at RM0.18 per sq ft inclusive of sinking fund, the standard 900 sq ft home works out to about RM162 a month, before any other costs. That gives you a cost to compare either way, though it doesn’t tell us what rent or return you might achieve. As you compare, is keeping monthly ownership costs manageable more important, or are you mainly testing whether the rental numbers could work?
